title: Dynarray.blit with src_pos max_int raises and leaves the destination corrupt
summary: `Dynarray.blit ~src_pos:max_int ~len:1` with `~dst_pos` at the end of the destination raises `Invalid_argument`, as documented, but leaves the destination one element longer with no element there. Every later traversal of it raises.

actual.text: Prints `result Invalid_argument "Invalid dynarray (unsynchronized concurrent length change): missing element at position 3 < length 4"`.

cause: `stdlib/dynarray.ml`, `blit`: `src_pos + len` overflows in the bounds test, and the length of the destination is set before `Array.blit` refuses.
